provenance.policy: Exact complete faces; frontend expansion is not gameplay certification.

rule_text.text: Each Module card has a striated text box containing three submodule bars. Its illustration is vertically oriented on the left side of the card, and its type line is along the bottom of the card.

A submodule is a keyword ability that represents an activated ability. A submodule bar includes the activation cost of its activated ability and a flavor word. Any abilities printed within the same text box section as the submodule bar are part of its activated ability.

rule_text.name: 749.2a
rule_text.text: “[Cost]: [Flavor word] — [Effect]” means “[Cost]: [Effect]. Activate this ability only once. Activate this ability only as a sorcery or if a spell or ability instructs you to activate a submodule.”
A Module card has the intrinsic ability “When this permanent enters the battlefield, you may activate one of its submodules without paying its activation cost.”

executable_definitions.reminder: Flavor-word bars name submodules. This layout has three submodule bars. Each bar is an activated ability with its printed cost and complete section effect. Activate each bar only once. Activate bars only as a sorcery or when instructed to activate a submodule. When this permanent enters the battlefield you may activate one of its submodules without paying its activation cost.
